title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 53
paragraphs: This is the account given by the Lacedaemonians alone of all the Hellenes; but what follows I write in accordance with the general report of the Hellenes: namely, that the names of these kings of the Dorians are correctly enumerated by the Hellenes back to Perseus son of Danaë (leaving out the god), and are shown to be of Hellenic stock—for from that point they were already reckoned as Hellenes. I said “up to Perseus,” and did not trace the descent from a yet higher point, because no name of a mortal father is given for Perseus, as Amphitryon is for Heracles. With good reason, then, I have said “rightly up to Perseus”; but if one enumerates their ancestors in succession going back from Danaë daughter of Acrisius, the rulers of the Dorians will prove to be Egyptians by direct descent.
